summary: Prioritise property maintenance and renewal with lifecycle costing, condition assessment, and asset risk exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Property asset management training helps property and facilities professionals use building records to set maintenance and renewal priorities. Participants develop asset hierarchies, assess property condition, compare lifecycle costs, and prioritize asset risks to inform maintenance plans and capital decisions. The course is for property managers, facilities managers, and building operations leads who coordinate asset decisions and prepare owner reports.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who make or support decisions about building assets, maintenance, renewal, and property service continuity.
prerequisites: Intermediate level. You should have working exposure to property or facilities operations, such as maintenance coordination, building services, asset records, or property budgeting. No coding or programming is required. Excel familiarity supports the lifecycle-costing exercises.
